what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Guatemala by conflict and violence, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR and shown side by side.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 572813 people in internal displacement, and UNHCR counted 573000.
Refugees from Guatemala live mainly in the United States and Mexico.

why.text: The sources here don't record the causes of this displacement: there are no dated events or armed conflicts for Guatemala in them.
Storms, floods, earthquakes, mass movements, wildfires and extreme temperatures are the disasters recorded for Guatemala in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 242000 in 2013 to 572813 in 2023 and stayed there in 2024 and 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025, after a big change between 2022 and 2023, the year IDMC recorded the most new displacements from conflict.

how.text: UNHCR's and IDMC's figures overlap and are counted differently, so they are shown side by side and never added.
UNHCR's file shows 0 for 2024, which in UNHCR's data can mean 0 or not reported.
The sources don't say where inside Guatemala people moved to.
